title: New Luxe 5BR Resort | Pool, Pickleball | Theater
description:
Luxury resort-style retreat designed for groups, celebrations, golf trips, and family getaways.

• 8 min to Arizona State University
• 15 min to Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport
• 15 min to Spring Training stadiums & top-rated golf courses
• 20 min to Old Town Scottsdale

Enjoy a private pickleball court, heated pool, hot tub, movie room, arcade, poker lounge, putting green, chef-inspired kitchen, and thoughtfully curated spaces designed for connection, relaxation, and unforgettable memories together.

 The space 
KEY FEATURES

☀ Sleeps up to 20 guests
☀ Private pickleball court with premium equipment
☀ Heated pool + hot tub
☀ Two shaded cabanas
☀ Outdoor poolside TV
☀ Movie room with 100" display
☀ Speakeasy-style poker lounge
☀ Arcade/game room
☀ Putting green + floating pool target
☀ Chef-inspired kitchen
☀ Premium Nespresso coffee station
☀ Smeg appliances
☀ Family-friendly amenities (Pack 'n Play, high chair, books & games)
☀ Smart TVs throughout
☀ Blackout curtains in all bedrooms
☀ Outdoor fireplaces
☀ Fast Wi-Fi (250 Mbps +)
☀ Free parking for 10 vehicles

BEDROOMS + BATHROOMS

The home comfortably sleeps up to 20 guests across spacious sleeping areas featuring premium Purple mattresses, quality linens, blackout curtains, Smart TVs, charging stations, and ample storage throughout.

The primary suite includes King Bed, a private ensuite bathroom and a sleeper sofa good 2 kids, while additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for families, golf groups, sports teams, and multi-family vacations.

Bathrooms are stocked with plush towels, robes, hair dryers, and essential amenities for a comfortable stay.

RESORT-STYLE BACKYARD

The backyard is the centerpiece of the experience. Spend your days relaxing by the heated pool, soaking in the hot tub, enjoying shaded cabanas, or watching the game on the 75" outdoor TV.

As the sun sets, warm lighting transforms the space into your own private resort perfect for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together.

PICKLEBALL, PUTTING & OUTDOOR FUN

Challenge your group on the private pickleball court with premium paddles, tournament-style scoring, and equipment provided for players of all skill levels. Practice your short game on the putting green or take aim at the floating target in the pool.

Whether you're hosting a tournament, a golf getaway, or simply having fun with friends and family, there's something for everyone.

KITCHEN & DINING

The chef-inspired kitchen was designed for both convenience and entertaining. Dining table can seat 10 guests, kitchen island seats 4, covered outside table seats 8. 

Enjoy premium cookware, chef-grade knives, serving platters, cheese boards, Smeg appliances, and a fully stocked Nespresso coffee station, coffee press, large programmable coffee pot - featuring premium syrups, specialty accessories, and local coffee selections perfect for everything from quick breakfasts to memorable group dinners.

LOUNGE SPACES

Gather in the spacious living room featuring comfortable seating, a large Roku TV, curated board games, puzzles, card games, and a premium Mahjong set.

Designed for connection and conversation, it's the perfect space to unwind between adventures.

MOVIE ROOM, ARCADE & POKER LOUNGE

Enjoy a dedicated theater room with a massive 100" display that comfortably seats 8 adults and more with kids, a full arcade featuring air hockey, skee-ball, Fast & Furious racing, and 1,000+ arcade games.

For a more elevated evening, retreat to the speakeasy-inspired poker lounge complete with premium gaming tables, bar seating, beverage fridge, and multiple TVs.

FRONT PORCH

Start your day on the front porch swing while watching the Arizona sunrise beside the soothing fountain—the perfect spot for coffee and quiet moments before the day begins.

We hope your stay becomes one of those stories you'll be telling for years.

Proudly hosted by Wilder Stays — Wild Hospitality. Thoughtfully Delivered.

 Guest access 
Guests will have private access to the entire property, including:

• Private pickleball court with premium equipment
• Heated pool & hot tub
• Movie room
• Poker lounge
• Arcade/game room
• Putting green
• Outdoor entertaining spaces
• Garage and driveway parking

Free parking available for up to 10 vehicles.

 Other things to note 
Enjoy peace of mind during your stay. The property is professionally cleaned and prepared before every arrival.

For guest safety, exterior security cameras monitor outdoor front area only and record audio/video. Cameras do not monitor interior spaces.
Pool heating may require an additional fee (if applicable).
Outdoor wood-burning fireplace is available October–May, weather and local restrictions permitting.

Check-in is flexible anytime after 4 PM. Pack 'n Play and high chair available.
